direct_work_policy: Direct implementation tickets are separate from the historical scheduler mapping; no scheduled task is created or required.

direct_work_tickets.objective: Execute one approved 25-minute zero-model readiness job with the existing digest-bound verifier: five immutable archive replays and four synthetic adapter/product-transfer requests, then independently verify signed artifacts.
acceptance: Only the exact readiness branch push starts the diagnostic; no image rebuild, model call, publication or merge.
Historical ZIP and report digests match before replay; original candidate bytes are not repaired.
All five fixed fixture gates pass through the real adapter and signed verifier, not mocks.
Signatures, run/image bindings and SQLite blob readback are independently checked.
No scientific credit; inspect results before any larger pilot.

direct_work_tickets.objective: Run exactly one synthetic signed Mathlib reflexivity control on the existing immutable verifier image and retain honest phase observations; no model calls, rebuild, benchmark change or scientific credit.
acceptance: A dedicated branch push cannot launch historical pilot or image-build workflows.
The exact local source and 60-second per-phase watchdog are preserved.
Signatures, input/run binding and database readback are verified before reporting readiness.
Running containers never report an observed successful exit.
Result is retained and reviewed before any subsequent execution.

tickets.objective: Trace the merged report-access attestation through the live activation, execution-authority, and manifest boundaries and publish an exact implementation handoff without changing any frozen scientific input.
acceptance: The audit cites exact repository files, symbols, and current digests.
Every missing report-attestation binding is mapped to a concrete implementation seam and deterministic test.
Public reconstructibility is kept distinct from integrity and statement-fidelity evidence.
No production execution or scientific-rule change occurs.

tickets.objective: Implement the external runtime trust-root boundary so repository content is evidence but never the root of production authority; expose a narrow validated capability for the later integration ticket.
acceptance: Production validation requires an independently supplied trusted root identity.
A repository-only trust-root or key substitution is rejected.
Draft and test fixtures remain explicitly non-production.
No authority artifacts are reprovisioned and no production execution occurs.

tickets.objective: Implement durable one-shot production activation as an independently testable component, without dispatching a cohort or changing frozen scientific inputs.
acceptance: The first valid activation consumes exactly one externally identified activation nonce.
Replay, concurrent reuse, and a second activation attempt are rejected deterministically.
Crash-safe state transitions are tested with temporary storage.
Draft activation remains non-credit and no production dispatch occurs.

tickets.objective: Build a pure pre-dispatch request and response byte-cap validator from the frozen cost policy so the later supervisor integration cannot send or accept an oversized payload.
acceptance: Exact request and response limits are read from the frozen policy rather than duplicated as new thresholds.
The validator accepts exactly-at-limit bytes and rejects one-byte-over values.
Invalid UTF-8 and aggregate-limit violations are fail-closed.
The component performs no model call and changes no frozen artifact.

tickets.objective: Add exact supervisor-source and report-access-attestation bindings to the trusted-host supervisor interface while preserving the already sealed scientific rules.
acceptance: The supervisor identity binds the exact reviewed source bytes.
The report-access attestation digest is required and mismatch is rejected.
Existing preflight and execution-authority behavior remains additive and backward-tested.
No authority artifact is signed or production cohort dispatched.

tickets.objective: Attack the frozen complete-cost and terminal-state semantics with additive regression tests before the activation components are integrated.
acceptance: Unknown, missing, or over-budget cost remains BLOCKED or INCOMPLETE and never becomes PASS or FAIL.
Every arm uses the same frozen observable cost basis.
Exact budget boundaries and mixed-basis substitutions are probed.
Any implementation defect is reported without modifying the frozen policy.

tickets.objective: Build a deterministic dry-run reprovisioner for all derived public authority artifacts so the later integration ticket can regenerate them once from reviewed inputs without exposing keys or executing the cohort.
acceptance: The tool derives canonical bytes and digests from explicit reviewed inputs only.
It refuses missing external trust material, stale source bindings, and partial output sets.
Dry-run output is deterministic and cannot be mistaken for signed production authority.
No credential, private key, production signature, or held-out execution is created.

tickets.objective: Require production evidence to contain an authenticated host-issued Lean verifier receipt that binds the exact source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, and result before evaluator projection.
acceptance: A caller-supplied LeanVerifierReceipt is insufficient for production credit.
An Ed25519-authenticated host receipt joins the exact source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, and verifier result.
Verifier evidence is persisted atomically, read back, replay-checked, and projected through the real evaluator boundary.
Draft and non-credit evidence remains explicitly non-production.
Adversarial tests reject fabricated PASS results and source, candidate, runtime, dispatch, or signature substitution.

tickets.objective: Make the production manifest require exact external-trust, one-shot-activation, supervisor-source, and report-attestation bindings supplied by the later integrated authority capability.
acceptance: Draft manifests remain deterministic and non-credit.
Production reconstruction rejects any missing or mismatched new binding.
Problem membership, arm allocation, prompts, attempt quotas, and budgets do not change.
No production manifest is activated in this ticket.

tickets.objective: Audit the real evidence-bridge-to-evaluator boundary for any path that could turn fabricated, blocked, incomplete, or unmatched evidence into scientific credit, and hand exact findings to implementation owners.
acceptance: The audit traces concrete call paths and names exact evidence fields.
Each finding includes a reproducible counterexample or a deterministic negative confirmation.
PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and INCOMPLETE semantics are checked separately.
The audit makes no scientific result claim.

tickets.objective: Prepare the independent adversarial attack matrix for the parallel activation components so the final merged suite can be written immediately after integration.
acceptance: The plan covers external-root substitution, activation replay, forged verifier PASS, source and attestation substitution, and exact byte-cap boundaries.
Every attack names the real production entry point and expected fail-closed outcome.
The plan identifies any attack that cannot yet be executed and the exact missing seam.
No reviewed implementation code is authored by this ticket.

tickets.objective: Produce an external-boundary threat model for the activation path, scoped to credential isolation, repository compromise, replay, sandbox escape, and evidence substitution.
acceptance: Trust assumptions and attacker capabilities are explicit and testable.
Repository integrity, runtime authority, content authenticity, and scientific validity are separated.
Every high-impact threat maps to an existing or newly dispatched control and owner.
Unmitigated threats are labeled blockers rather than assumed away.

tickets.objective: Open and maintain a review-only preactivation dossier over the exact parallel tranche; review every contribution but author no reviewed implementation and create no scientific credit.
acceptance: The dossier binds every reviewed PR head and relevant test output.
Path-scope, frozen-input preservation, authority separation, and unresolved integrity findings are explicit.
The provisional verdict remains AMEND while any required component or evidence is missing.
A final PASS is impossible until the later integrated adversarial suite is complete.

tickets.objective: Build and run a non-credit integration rehearsal against current main to expose activation seams while production dispatch remains forbidden.
acceptance: The rehearsal uses synthetic or development fixtures only and emits no confirmatory evidence.
Every missing component is reported as a typed seam failure.
The harness is idempotent and cannot consume the production activation nonce.
No held-out problem, model dispatch, or scientific adjudication occurs.

tickets.objective: Publish a status-only map of the parallel activation tranche, exact PR and CI state, remaining integration order, and the explicit continued block on scientific execution.
acceptance: The report distinguishes assigned, implemented, merged, reviewed, integrated, and executed states.
Every claim binds a repository artifact, PR, workflow, or typed absence.
No missing evidence is summarized as FAIL and no preparatory work is summarized as PASS.
The next executable manager action is stated without changing project authority.
